rule.completion: Every candidate run must fully clear and have zero truth-hull violations; missing runs disqualify.
rule.pool_gate: Candidate-minus-current mean penalized time must be <=0 in each of calibrated/broad/stress.
rule.primary: Among eligible candidates choose smallest calibrated mean total time; ties use declared arm order.
rule.secondary: If eligible and not primary, retain coverage as an additional conservative comparator.
rule.confirmation: Current plus frozen eligible selection only; no new selection from confirmation.
rule.ci: Pointwise paired bootstrap, 2000 draws; per-pool/composition/mechanism reporting; not multiplicity-adjusted.
rule.population: Each synthetic design pool reported separately; calibrated mixture is not an official population estimate.
